text:
Priya N.: Hi all 1 I'm Priya, starting in Design. Stuck on Okta: trying to enroll a passkey from my iPad (iPadOS 17, Safari) and the flow flashes "Enrollment started" then goes back to the main page. No confirmation or email. 1Password invite also missing. Anyone know common fixes?
People Ops: Welcome Priya! :wave: Tagging IT Support to triage. @it-support can you assist?
IT Support: Hey Priya, welcome. Can you confirm if you're using a company device or personal iPad, and whether you're on the corporate Wi-Fi or home network? Also which Apple ID is on the iPad (work or personal)?
Priya N.: Personal iPad, home wifi. Apple ID is personal. I tapped "Use Passkey" and used Face ID, it seemed to accept, but the web page redirected and didn't show success. No Okta Verify email either.
Design Lead: Welcome Priya! For quick access ping me and I can share mockups via a shared link once Drive works.
IT Support: Hmm, iPad passkey flows can get weird if cross-site cookies or third-party tracking is blocked. In Safari Settings > Privacy & Security, is "Prevent Cross-Site Tracking" enabled? Also try enabling "Allow All Cookies" temporarily.
Priya N.: Prevent Cross-Site Tracking was on. Turned it off and retried, still same behavior. Console logs from the desktop (mimicking flow) showed: "OktaWebAuthn: registration response missing attestation". Not sure how helpful that is.
Security: Since it's a personal device, we usually allow a short device-trust exception instead of messing with passkeys on personal devices. @people-ops can we do a 6-hour exception so Priya can get access and then enroll via a company iPad later?
People Ops: Yes we can. Priya, do you want the temporary exception or prefer to try Okta Verify (mobile) first?
Priya N.: Exception is fine. I'd like to get Drive and Slack now. Also 1Password invite should be to priya.design@redwood.com; can you check where it's queued?
IT Support: Granting temp-device-trust for 6h and re-sending Okta enrollment via SMS/Okta Verify fallback. Also checking 1Password: looks like invite bounced because the alias hadn't been fully provisioned in Google Workspace. I'll nudge provisioning.
onboard-bot: Provisioning snapshot: Okta: temp_device_trust=enabled duration=6h, GoogleWorkspace: alias_pending, 1Password: invite_status=pending target=priya.design@redwood.com
Priya N.: Got the SMS code and enrolled via Okta Verify. Drive is accessible now. Thank you! Still no 1Password invite though.
IT Support: Provisioning for the alias completed; 1Password invite resent. Please check spam. If not received, DM and we'll use a temporary emergency vault link.
Priya N.: Invite arrived and I can log in. Everything works now. Thanks for the quick help everyone :tada:
Design Lead: Welcome to the team! I'll add you to #design-crit and share the Figma starter file.
Security: Quick note: since a temp-device-trust exception was used, we'll perform a posture check audit. Priya, if you later enroll with a corporate device, please remove the temporary passkeys on your personal iPad to avoid lingering credentials.
Priya N.: Will do. Appreciate the assist!
